header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Values hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. Rate: flat 3% of Louisiana taxable income (since 2025). Standard deduction: statutory $12,500 single/MFS and $25,000 joint / qualifying surviving spouse / head of household, CPI-U indexed from 2026. LDR RIB 26-005 (Jan 12, 2026): for the 2026 withholding tables "a standard deduction of $12,875 was used for single and married-filing-separately taxpayers, and $25,750 for married-filing-jointly, qualifying surviving spouse, and head-of-household taxpayers. The official 2026 standard deduction amounts may be slightly different based on CPI-U data released in January 2026". The official final 2026 return amounts were not located, so these provisional amounts are used and status is "projected"; LDR's published 2026 retirement exemption ($12,324 = $12,000 x 1.027) suggests the final figures could be nearer $12,838 / $25,675. Tax Foundation 2026 shows no personal or dependent exemptions. Starts from federal AGI. Social Security benefits are not taxed. Retirement income exemption for persons 65 or older: $12,324 per person for 2026 (LDR Notice of Intent, Louisiana Register June 20, 2026: "For tax year 2026, this amount is $12,324 after being adjusted for inflation"; https://dam.ldr.la.gov/lawspolicies/NOI-1311.pdf); many Louisiana state/local and federal public retirement benefits are separately exempt in full (not modeled). No general capital-gains exclusion. No local income taxes. Cross-checked against Tax Foundation, "State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026" (data as of Jan 1 2026, updated Feb 11 2026). Tax Foundation 2026 also shows $12,875 / $25,750.

flags.standardDeduction: unverified: provisional 2026 amounts from LDR withholding guidance (RIB 26-005); final CPI-adjusted return amounts may differ slightly (possibly about $12,838 / $25,675)
flags.retirementIncomeExclusion: simplified: $12,324 per person at 65+ for other retirement income; many Louisiana and federal public pensions are fully exempt at any age
